questions.question: Primary Ciliary Dyskinesia (PCD) is a rare genetic disorder that primarily affects which part of the human body?
questions.explanation: Primary Ciliary Dyskinesia (PCD) is a rare genetic disorder that affects the cilia, which are tiny hair-like structures that help move mucus and other particles out of the respiratory tract. When cilia do not function effectively, mucus builds up, increasing the risk of recurrent infections.
questions.background: Cilia are essential for protecting the lungs from inhaled pathogens and irritants. Dysfunction of cilia in PCD can lead to chronic respiratory problems, including bronchiectasis and recurrent sinus infections.
questions.examRelevance: Primary Ciliary Dyskinesia (PCD) is a genetic disorder affecting cilia in the respiratory tract.
